name: PEG-6 caprylic/capric glycerides
description: PEG-6 caprylic/capric glycerides (CAS 361459-38-3 ) is an ethoxylated medium-chain glyceride derived from coconut or palm kernel oil fractions. It functions as an emulsifier, solubilizer, and carrier across pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food-grade formulation systems. In pharmaceutical drug delivery, it solubilizes poorly water-soluble active ingredients, improving bioavailability in soft gel capsules and self-emulsifying drug delivery systems. This makes it a critical component for modern medicine delivery. Cosmetic formulators use it to stabilize oil-in-water emulsions in creams, lotions, and leave-on skin care products. Its humectant character supports moisture retention in the finished formula, providing a smooth and hydrated skin feel. In nutraceutical and functional food applications, it enables lipophilic vitamin and omega fatty acid dispersions in liquid and encapsulated formats. This ensures consistent dosing and stability for various health supplements. Home care and industrial cleaning formulations use it as a low-irritation surfactant component in mild cleansing concentrates. Its gentle nature makes it suitable for products designed for sensitive environments and applications. PEG-6 caprylic/capric glycerides is typically supplied as a liquid or semi-solid at room temperature, available in bulk drums and intermediate bulk containers. This allows for flexible storage and handling in large-scale production. Pharmaceutical-grade material is offered to USP /NF and Ph. Eur. specifications, supporting regulated drug product manufacturing. These standards ensure the highest level of safety and efficacy for medical use. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade variants are also commercially available, with supplier documentation covering purity and HLB value.
